Determine our clustering sizes and number of samples to do

```{python}
###################
### Define Runs ###
###################

state_county_data["cluster_factor"] = np.int32(np.round(np.sqrt(state_county_data["size_precinct"] * state_county_data["size_county"])))

def make_array_str(sc_line: gpd.GeoDataFrame, iterations=30):
    return f"{{{{{int(sc_line['cluster_factor'])}, {iterations}}}, {{{int(sc_line['size_county'])}, {iterations}}}}}"

display(state_county_data)
# Sample usage:
# make_array_str(state_county_data[(state_county_data["state"] == "OH") & (state_county_data["year"] == 2024)])
```

```{python}
##############################
### Define Async Functions ###
##############################

loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()

# Define asynchronous function decorator to allow for asynchronous execution within the loop
def asyn(f):
    global loop
    def wrapped(*args, **kwargs):
        global loop
        return loop.run_in_executor(None, f, *args, **kwargs)
    return wrapped

def aawait(f):
    global loop
    return loop.run_until_complete(f)
```

Run our clustering algorithm on all possible state precint distributions

```{python}
##########################################################
### Async Run State Simulations (May take a long time) ###
##########################################################

@asyn
def do_state(sc_line: gpd.GeoDataFrame, iterations: int):
    global runs
    con = activateCon()
    cur = con.cursor()
    id = cur.execute("select create_layers(%(layers)s::INT[][], %(runid)s);", {'layers': make_array_str(sc_line, iterations), 'runid': sc_line["runid_precinct"]}).fetchall()[0][0]
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    print(id)

ITERATIONS = 30

tasks = [do_state(state, ITERATIONS) for state in state_county_data.iloc]

# To recover from issues
# tasks = [do_state(state, ITERATIONS) for state, t in zip(state_county_data.iloc, tasks) if t.exception() is not None]

while True:
    print(f"Working... {"".join(["T" if i.done() else "F" for i in tasks])}")
    if all([i.done() for i in tasks]):
        break
    aawait(asyncio.sleep(2))
```

Obtain all simulation results with some statistics before running more analysis

```{python}
################################
### Pull All Simulation Data ###
################################

con = activateCon()
cur = con.cursor()

results = gpd.GeoDataFrame(cur.execute('''
        SELECT 
            rg.resid,
            rg.runid,
            s.abbreviation,
            s.state_name,
            m.election_year,
            r_act.dem AS actual_dem_seats,
            r_act.rep AS actual_rep_seats,
            r_act.total AS total_seats
        FROM result_group AS rg
        JOIN meta AS m ON rg.runid = m.runid
        JOIN state_lookup AS s ON m.state = s.fips_code
        JOIN meta AS m_act ON m.state = m_act.state 
            AND m.election_year = m_act.election_year
            AND m_act.type = 1  -- Make sure we get real-world data
        JOIN results AS r_act ON m_act.runid = r_act.runid
        WHERE rg.layers <> '{{0, 0}}';
    ''').fetchall(),
    columns=['resid', 'runid', 's_abbr', 's_name', 'year', 'dem', 'rep', 'total']
)

display(results)
con.close()

# Sample usage:
# results[(results["s_abbr"] == "OH") & (results["year"] == 2020)]
```

# Methods for calculating statistics and visualizing our simulated data

```{python}
#######################################
### Way to get distribution results ###
#######################################

def get_state_distribution(resid: int):
    con = activateCon()
    cur = con.cursor()

    res = gpd.GeoDataFrame(cur.execute('''
        select r.dem, r.rep, r.total
        from results r
        where r.resid = %(resid)s
    ''', {'resid': resid}).fetchall(), columns=['dem', 'rep', 'total'])
    con.close()

    return res
```

```{python}
######################
### Visualize data ###
######################

def visualize_state(stats_df, state, year, dem, rep, total, save=False):
    if save:
        mpl.use("Agg")
    else:
        mpl.use("inline")
    
    # Setup Plotting Calculations
    rows = len(stats_df)
    # x_axis for the Normal PDF curves
    x_axis = np.linspace(0, total, 500)
    # Ensure bin_size is at least 1
    bin_size = max(1, int(np.ceil(total / 100)))

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(integer=True))

    # Plot Democratic Results
    plt.hist(stats_df["dem"], bins=range(0, total + 2, bin_size), 
             color='b', weights=[1/rows/bin_size]*rows, 
             align="left", alpha=0.3, edgecolor='black', label="Dem Histogram")
    
    if stats_df["dem"].std() > 0:
        plt.plot(x_axis, norm.pdf(x_axis, loc=stats_df["dem"].mean(), scale=stats_df["dem"].std()), 
                 color='b', linewidth=1.5, label="Dem Norm Dist")
    
    plt.axvline(x=dem, color='b', linestyle='dashed', 
                linewidth=2, label=f"Dem Actual ({dem})")

    # Plot Republican Results
    plt.hist(stats_df["rep"], bins=range(0, total + 2, bin_size), 
             color='r', weights=[1/rows/bin_size]*rows, 
             align="left", alpha=0.3, edgecolor='black', label="Rep Histogram")
    
    if stats_df["rep"].std() > 0:
        plt.plot(x_axis, norm.pdf(x_axis, loc=stats_df["rep"].mean(), scale=stats_df["rep"].std()), 
                 color='r', linewidth=1.5, label="Rep Norm Dist")
        
    plt.axvline(x=rep, color='r', linestyle='dashed', 
                linewidth=2, label=f"Rep Actual ({rep})")

    # Aesthetics
    plt.title(f"{state} ({year}) County Seat Distributions")
    plt.xlabel("Number of Counties Won")
    plt.ylabel("Probability Density")
    plt.legend(fontsize='small')
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    if save:
        plt.savefig(f"plots/hist_{state}_{year}.svg", format='svg', bbox_inches='tight')

    return fig, ax
```

```{python}
#################################
### Plot s-curve for a result ###
#################################

def plot_partisan_ribbon(stats_df, state_name, year, save=False):
    """
    Plots a shaded confidence ribbon of simulated partisan leans 
    with the actual county baseline overlaid.
    """
    if save:
        mpl.use("Agg")
    else:
        mpl.use("inline")

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))
    
    x = stats_df['rank']

    # Plot ribbons
    ax.fill_between(x, stats_df['p0'], stats_df['p100'], 
                    color='gray', alpha=0.2, label='100% Simulation Range')
    ax.fill_between(x, stats_df['p5'], stats_df['p95'], 
                    color='gray', alpha=0.4, label='90% Simulation Range')
    ax.fill_between(x, stats_df['p25'], stats_df['p75'], 
                    color='gray', alpha=0.6, label='50% Simulation Range (IQR)')
    
    # Plot the Median Simulation Line
    ax.plot(x, stats_df['p50'], color='black', linewidth=1, 
            linestyle='--', label='Median Simulation')

    # Plot the Actual County Baseline
    ax.plot(stats_df.index + 1, stats_df['actual'], 
            color='#d7191c', linewidth=2, label='Actual Counties')

    # Add decision line
    ax.axhline(0.5, color='black', linewidth=1, label='50% (Win Threshold)')
    
    # Shade the "Democratic Win Zone" lightly
    ax.axhspan(0.5, 1.0, color='blue', alpha=0.05)
    # Shade the "Republican Win Zone" lightly
    ax.axhspan(0.0, 0.5, color='red', alpha=0.05)

    # Labels and Titles
    ax.set_title(f"Partisan Lean Analysis: {state_name} ({year})", fontsize=16, pad=20)
    ax.set_xlabel("District Rank (Sorted by Democratic Lean)", fontsize=12)
    ax.set_ylabel("Democratic Vote Share (%)", fontsize=12)
    
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax.set_xlim(1, len(x))
    ax.legend(frameon=True)
    plt.tight_layout()

    if save:
        plt.savefig(f"plots/s_{state_name}_{year}.svg", format='svg', bbox_inches='tight')
    
    return fig, ax
```

```{python}
#################################################
### Calculate deviance stats for any grouping ###
#################################################

def calculate_ensemble_stats(county_dist):
    # Convert data to numpy array
    sim_matrix = np.array(list(zip_longest(*county_dist['ensemble'], fillvalue=None)))
    sim_matrix[sim_matrix == None] = np.nan
    sim_matrix = sim_matrix.astype(float)

    # Calculate population metrics
    pop_means = np.nanmean(sim_matrix, axis=0)
    pop_stds = np.nanstd(sim_matrix, axis=0)
    pop_stds = np.where(pop_stds == 0, 1e-6, pop_stds)

    # Vectorized D-score for the Ensemble
    z_scores_pop = (sim_matrix - pop_means) / pop_stds
    population_d = np.sqrt(np.nanmean(z_scores_pop**2, axis=1))

    # Actual Map D-score
    actual_leans = county_dist['actual'].values
    z_scores_query = (actual_leans - pop_means) / pop_stds
    query_d = np.sqrt(np.nanmean(z_scores_query**2))

    # Clean up and return
    valid_pop_d = population_d[~np.isnan(population_d)]
    p_value = np.sum(valid_pop_d >= query_d) / len(valid_pop_d)

    return {
        'p_value': p_value,
        'percentile': (1 - p_value) * 100,
        'query_d': query_d,
        'population_d': valid_pop_d
    }
```

```{python}
%matplotlib inline

###################################
### Plot the deviance histogram ###
###################################

def plot_deviance_distribution(stats_output, state_name, year, save=False):
    """
    Plots a histogram of the D-score distribution with the actual map's position.
    """
    if save:
        mpl.use("Agg")
    else:
        mpl.use("inline")

    pop_d = stats_output['population_d']
    query_d = stats_output['query_d']
    p_val = stats_output['p_value']
    percentile = stats_output['percentile']

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

    # Plot the Distribution
    count, bins, ignored = ax.hist(
        pop_d,
        bins=35,
        density=True,
        color="#95a5a6",
        alpha=0.4,
        edgecolor='white',
        label="Simulated Neutral Maps"
    )

    # Add the KDE (Smooth Curve)
    kde = gaussian_kde(pop_d)
    x_range = np.linspace(min(pop_d), max(max(pop_d), query_d) * 1.1, 500)
    ax.plot(x_range, kde(x_range), color="#7f8c8d", lw=2)

    # Add the Map Indicator (Vertical Line)
    ax.axvline(
        query_d,
        color="#e74c3c",
        linestyle="--",
        linewidth=2.5,
        label=f"D={query_d:.2f}"
    )

    # Annotation Box
    textstr = "\n".join((
        f"Ensemble Size: {len(pop_d)}",
        f"Percentile Rank: {percentile:.1f}%",
        f"p-value: {p_val:.4f}"
    ))
    
    props = dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8, edgecolor='#bdc3c7')
    ax.text(0.05, 0.95, textstr, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=11,
            verticalalignment='top', bbox=props)

    # 5. Labels and Titles
    ax.set_title(f"Empirical Partisan Deviance Distribution: {state_name} ({year})", fontsize=15, pad=20)
    ax.set_xlabel("Total Deviance Score (D)", fontsize=12)
    ax.set_ylabel("Probability Density", fontsize=12)
    ax.legend(loc='upper right')

    plt.tight_layout()

    if save:
        plt.savefig(f"plots/dev_{state_name}_{year}.svg", format='svg', bbox_inches='tight')

    return fig, ax
```

```{python}
%matplotlib inline

###################################
### Plot all results (and save) ###
###################################

for i in results.iloc:
    fig, ax = visualize_state(
        get_state_distribution(int(i["resid"])),
        i["s_name"],
        int(i["year"]),
        int(i["dem"]),
        int(i["rep"]),
        int(i["total"]),
        save = True
    )
    plt.close(fig)

    county_dist = get_county_distribution(int(i["resid"]))
    stat = calculate_ensemble_stats(county_dist)
    fig, ax = plot_deviance_distribution(stat, i["s_name"], int(i["year"]), save = True)
    plt.close(fig)

    fig, ax = plot_partisan_ribbon(
        county_dist,
        i["s_name"],
        int(i["year"]),
        save = True
    )
    plt.close(fig)
```

Generate sample maps

```{python}
################################
### Get geometry assignments ###
################################

def get_run_geometries(runid: int):
    con = activateCon()
    data = gpd.GeoDataFrame.from_postgis('''
        select groupid, runid, dem, rep, total, geo
        from groups
        where runid = %(id)s;
    ''', con=con, params={'id': runid}, geom_col='geo')
    con.close()
    return data
```

```{python}
%matplotlib inline

#####################
### Plot geometry ###
#####################

def visualize_run_map(runid: int, state_name, save=False):
    if save:
        mpl.use("Agg")
    else:
        mpl.use("inline")

    data = get_run_geometries(runid)

    if data.empty:
        print(f"No data found for runid {runid}")
        return

    # Calculate Partisan Lean (Dem %)
    data['lean'] = data['dem'] / (data['dem'] + data['rep']).replace(0, np.nan)

    # Project to Web Mercator for the basemap
    data = data.to_crs(epsg=3857)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 10))

    # Draw the polygons
    # 'RdBu' is Red (GOP) to Blue (Dem). 0.5 will be white/purple.
    data.plot(
        column='lean',
        cmap='RdBu',
        norm=Normalize(vmin=0, vmax=1),
        edgecolor="gray",
        linewidth=1.5,
        alpha=0.6,
        ax=ax,
        legend=True,
        legend_kwds={'label': "Republican <-> Democratic Vote Share", 'orientation': "horizontal", 'pad': 0.02}
    )

    # Add the Basemap
    cx.add_basemap(ax, source=cx.providers.OpenStreetMap.Mapnik)

    # Aesthetics
    ax.set_axis_off()
    plt.title(f"Simulation {runid}: {state_name} Partisan Lean", fontsize=15, pad=10)

    if save:
        plt.savefig(f"plots/map_{state_name}_{runid}.svg", format='svg', bbox_inches='tight')

    return fig, ax
```
